ApplicantRequestNumber.name: Applicant Request Number
ApplicantRequestNumber.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier assigned by the applicant to the undertaking amendment request.

Applicant.name: Applicant
Applicant.definition: Party requesting the issuance of the amendment.

TerminationDetails.name: Termination Details
TerminationDetails.definition: Details concerning the requested termination of the undertaking.

IncreaseDecreaseAmount.name: Increase Decrease Amount
IncreaseDecreaseAmount.definition: Indication of the amount of increase or decrease to the undertaking amount.

NewExpiryDetails.name: New Expiry Details
NewExpiryDetails.definition: Requested new expiry terms for the undertaking.

NewBeneficiary.name: New Beneficiary
NewBeneficiary.definition: Requested new beneficiary of the undertaking.

NewUndertakingTermsAndConditions.name: New Undertaking Terms And Conditions
NewUndertakingTermsAndConditions.definition: Requested new terms and conditions of the undertaking.

CounterUndertaking.name: Counter Undertaking
CounterUndertaking.definition: Amendment details related to the counter-undertaking.

DeliveryChannel.name: Delivery Channel
DeliveryChannel.definition: Communication channel for delivery of the amendment.

EnclosedFile.name: Enclosed File
EnclosedFile.definition: Document or template enclosed in the request.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Additional information related to the request.
